methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Drones & Autonomous (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 7 same-sector peers exist in Drones & Autonomous, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Dynamo Air is a pre-seed stage company in the Drones & Autonomous sector, founded by Ethan Blagg, whose prior experience includes co-founding Nexus Technologies and roles at Plumb Drone and Huub Creative. The valuation universe consists of eight private peers in the Drones & Autonomous space, including Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, Joby Aviation, and Nuro; no public comparables exist in this narrow segment.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this analysis. Although seven same-sector peers were identified within Drones & Autonomous, no narrow peer set meeting quality criteria could be constructed: zero companies matched on both stage and adjacent-stage filters, and zero fell within a comparable valuation tier. The dataset lacks the minimum three datapoints required for reliable peer-median triangulation. Falling back to all-sector median comparisons would introduce unacceptable noise given the heterogeneity of business models, capital intensity, and maturity across the broader autonomous systems landscape.

Given the absence of applicable quantitative methods with sufficient data density, a traditional triangulated valuation range cannot be derived from this dataset. The analysis is constrained by the stage (pre-seed), nascent market positioning, and the wide dispersion of outcomes among existing private peers. Any valuation for Dynamo Air at this stage should rely on qualitative assessment of founder background, product-stage clarity, and market timing rather than peer-based multiples or discounted cash flow analysis.
